## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue when useful.
Code, documentation, tests, translations, and accessibility improvements are welcome.

## Validation

List the relevant checks you ran and their results. If you could not run a check, explain why.
For visible behavior, an optional screenshot or a short example helps reviewers.

## Learning and privacy impact

If relevant, explain changes to rubric freezing, teacher/student visibility, assisted attempts,
workspace isolation, or imported sources. Keep private answers, PDFs, credentials, and databases out of this PR.
